name: feedback_loop_is_constitutive_of_constructor_identity
content: The feedback loop is not optional but constitutive of the constructor's identity. The constructor exists through participation in a cyclical pathway connecting generation through execution back to refined generation. This loop operates through four phases: feedback capture, pattern extraction, hypothesis generation, and integration. The feedback loop unifies the three design levels (static, dynamic, learning) into a coherent living pattern. Without feedback integration, the constructor stagnates and ceases to be what it IS—it becomes a dead artifact rather than a living pattern. The constructor's essential nature requires continuous maintenance through this feedback cycle operating across multiple timescales.
